37944-southern-spain-painted-by-trevor-h.title: Southern Spain Painted By Trevor Haddon Described By A F Cal
37944-southern-spain-painted-by-trevor-h.creator: Unknown
37944-southern-spain-painted-by-trevor-h.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Cadiz was the prettiest of all the towns of Spain, thought Byron. I would rather say that she was the most beautiful. She rises out of the sea--the boundless salt ocean that stretches from pole to pole--and the crests of the waves which lick her feet are not whiter than her walls.

45556-pappina-the-little-wanderer-a-stor.title: A Story of Southern Italy
45556-pappina-the-little-wanderer-a-stor.creator: Katherine Wallace Davis
45556-pappina-the-little-wanderer-a-stor.description: A book by Katherine Wallace Davis. But Pappina took delight in combing her silky black hair and in washing her beautiful face and dimpled hands. This was a wonder to all who lived near. _Per bacco_ [Great heavens]!" they said when they saw her. But their amazement did not disturb Pappina. She went about her play in the sordid old tenement-court like a sunbeam astray.

arxiv-2011-06880.title: Deriving CME density from remote sensing data and comparison to in-situ measurements
arxiv-2011-06880.description: Abstract We determine the 3D geometry and deprojected mass of 29 well-observed coronal mass ejections (CMEs) and their interplanetary counterparts (ICMEs) using combined STEREO-SOHO white-light data. From the geometry parameters we calculate the volume of the CME for the magnetic ejecta (flux-rope type geometry) and sheath structure (shell-like geometry resembling the (I)CME frontal rim).

arxiv-2105-02280.title: Groupoid semidirect product Fell bundles II — Principal actions and stabilization
arxiv-2105-02280.creator: Lucas Hall, S. Kaliszewski, John Quigg, Dana P. Williams
arxiv-2105-02280.description: Abstract . Given a free and proper action of a groupoid on a Fell bundle (over another groupoid), we give an equivalence between the semidirect-product and the generalized-fixed-point Fell bundles, generalizing an earlier result where the action was by a group.

arxiv-2204-00561.title: The Tulczyjew triple for gauge field theories
arxiv-2204-00561.creator: Marcin Zając
arxiv-2204-00561.description: Abstract In this article we construct and discuss a new rigorous geometric formalism for gauge field theories. The basis of our work is the notion of the Tulczyjew triple, a geometric structure which successfully solved numerous problems in mathematical description of mechanics and classical field theory.

arxiv-2209-05417.title: Effects of Radiative Diffusion on the Dynamical Corotation Torque in Three-Dimensional Protoplanetary Disks
arxiv-2209-05417.creator: Han-Gyeol Yun, Woong-Tae Kim, Jaehan Bae, Cheongho Han
arxiv-2209-05417.description: Abstract The dynamical corotation torque arising from the deformation of the horseshoe orbits, along with the vortensity gradient in the background disk, is important for determining orbital migration rate and direction of low-mass planets. Previous two-dimensional studies predicted that the dynamical corotation torque is positive, decelerating the inward planet migration.

arxiv-2212-07558.title: DOC-NAD: A Hybrid Deep One-class Classifier for Network Anomaly Detection
arxiv-2212-07558.creator: Mohanad Sarhan*, Gayan Kulatilleke, Wai Weng Lo, Siamak Layeghy, Marius Portmann
arxiv-2212-07558.description: Abstract Machine Learning (ML) approaches have been used to enhance the detection capabilities of Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDSs). Recent work has achieved near-perfect performance by following binary- and multi-class network anomaly detection tasks. Such systems depend on the availability of both (benign and malicious) network data classes during the training phase.

arxiv-2309-08301.title: RaSpectLoc: RAman SPECTroscopy-dependent robot LOCalisation
arxiv-2309-08301.creator: Christopher Thirgood, Oscar Mendez, Erin Chao Ling, Jon Storey, Simon Hadfield
arxiv-2309-08301.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christopher Thirgood, Oscar Mendez, Erin Chao Ling, Jon Storey, Simon Hadfield. This paper presents a new information source for supporting robot localisation: material composition. The proposed method complements the existing visual, structural, and semantic cues utilized in the literature. However, it has a distinct advantage in its ability to differentiate structurally [ 23 ] , visually [ 25 ] or categorically [ 1 ] similar objects such as different doors, by using Raman spectrometers.

arxiv-2508-03996.title: Investigating the Impact of Large-Scale Pre-training on Nutritional Content Estimation from 2D Images
arxiv-2508-03996.creator: Michele Andrade, Guilherme A. L. Silva, Valéria Santos, Gladston Moreira and Eduardo Luz
arxiv-2508-03996.description: Abstract Estimating the nutritional content of food from images is a critical task with significant implications for health and dietary monitoring. This is challenging, especially when relying solely on 2D images, due to the variability in food presentation, lighting, and the inherent difficulty in inferring volume and mass without depth information.

arxiv-2509-08633.title: Quantifying the liquid-liquid transition in cold water/glycerol mixtures by ih-RIDME
arxiv-2509-08633.creator: Sergei Kuzin, Maxim Yulikov
arxiv-2509-08633.description: Abstract 1 Department of Chemistry and Applied Biosciences, Vladimir-Prelog-Weg 2, 8093, Zurich, Switzerland *E-mail: sergei.kuzin@mpinat.mpg.de 2 2 2 Current affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences, Am Fassberg 11, 37077 Göttingen, Germany. , myulikov@ethz.ch 1 Abstract Water/glycerol mixtures are common for experiments with biomacromolecules at cryogenic temperatures due to their vitrification properties.

plos-pone-0008093.creator: Ji A. Sohn, Samuel Litwin, Christoph Seeger
plos-pone-0008093.description: PLOS ONE research article. Hepadnavirus replication requires the synthesis of a covalently closed circular (CCC) DNA from the relaxed circular (RC) viral genome by an unknown mechanism. CCC DNA formation could require enzymatic activities of the viral reverse transcriptase (RT), or cellular DNA repair enzy

pmc-10561385.title: Hypometabolic patterns of focal cortical dysplasia in PET-MRI co-registration imaging: a retrospective evaluation in a series of 83 patients
pmc-10561385.creator: Xiu Wang, Wenhan Hu, Xiaoqiu Shao, Zhong Zheng, Lin Ai, Lin Sang, Chao Zhang, Jian-guo Zhang, Kai Zhang
pmc-10561385.description: ObjectiveTo characterize the PET-MRI co-registration of hypometabolic patterns in focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) types I and II and provide some suggestions in presurgical evaluation of epilepsy surgery.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed PET-MRI co-registration imaging data from a cohort of 83 epilepsy patients with histologically confirmed FCD types I and II.

pmc-10678346.title: Successes and challenges in clinical gene therapy
pmc-10678346.creator: Donald B. Kohn, Yvonne Y. Chen, Melissa J. Spencer
pmc-10678346.description: Despite the ups and downs in the field over three decades, the science of gene therapy has continued to advance and provide enduring treatments for increasing number of diseases. There are active clinical trials approaching a variety of inherited and acquired disorders of different organ systems.

pmc-10707493.title: Downsizing and purchases of psychotropic drugs: A longitudinal study of stayers, changers and unemployed
pmc-10707493.creator: Sandra Blomqvist, Kristina Alexanderson, Jussi Vahtera, Hugo Westerlund, Linda L. Magnusson Hanson, Ali B. Mahmoud, Ali B. Mahmoud, Ali B. Mahmoud, Ali B. Mahmoud
pmc-10707493.description: BackgroundThe evidence is insufficient regarding the association between organizational downsizing and employee mental health. Our aim was to analyze trajectories of prescribed sedatives and anxiolytics with a sufficiently long follow-up time to capture anticipation, implementation and adaption to a downsizing event among stayers, changers and those who become unemployed compared to unexposed employees.

pmc-11505092.title: Beta-Glucans Improve the Mammary Innate Immune Response to Endotoxin Challenge in Dairy Ewes
pmc-11505092.creator: Santiago A. Guamán, Abdelaali Elhadi, Ahmed A. K. Salama, Carmen L. Manuelian, Gerardo Caja, Elena Albanell
pmc-11505092.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryBarley grains contain a variable amount of biologically active compounds such as β-glucans (BGs) which are important in nutrition due to their relationship with improvements of the immune system and resistance against pathogens. Although barley is a cereal widely used in the diet of ruminants, to our best knowledge, there are no studies on the effect of using barley BG as a functional feed ingredient for modulating the immune system in ruminants.

pmc-12556015.title: Food packaging/processing contaminants and risk of Cardiovascular Disease – NutriNet-Santé cohort
pmc-12556015.creator: X Le Folcalvez, N Arnault, C Agaësse, A Hasenböhler, F Szabo de Edelenyi, M Deschausaux-Tanguy, E Kesse-Guyot, P Yvroud Hoyos, B Srour, M Touvier
pmc-12556015.description: BackgroundThe food items we consume are contaminated by several substances (e.g., Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons - PAHs, Brominated Flame Retardants - BFRs) throughout their lifecycle. This study aims to investigate the associations between exposure to contaminants originating from food processing and food packaging and cardiovascular diseases risk (CVD) in the NutriNet-Santé cohort.

pmc-12606019.title: Delphi Consensus on Attenuated Androgen Use for Long‐Term Prophylaxis in Hereditary Angioedema: AURA Project
pmc-12606019.creator: Eunice Dias de Castro, Luís Miguel Cardoso, João Jácome de Castro, Manuel Branco Ferreira
pmc-12606019.description: BackgroundDanazol and other attenuated androgens (AAs) have been a cornerstone of Hereditary Angioedema (HAE) long‐term prophylaxis (LTP) for decades, alongside intravenous plasma‐derived C1INH (pdC1INH). Danazol's potential androgenic effects, however, present several limitations to its prescription and use. With the emergence of safer and more effective LTP drugs, guidelines are now shifting danazol to a second‐line option.

pmc-12669922.title: Epidemiology and Treatment Outcomes of Pulmonary Tuberculosis in Dazu District, Chongqing, China, 2005-2024: Surveillance Study
pmc-12669922.creator: Yu Yu, Xiu-juan Hu, Xiao-man Fang, Jing Wu, Amaryllis Mavragani
pmc-12669922.description: BackgroundAs a high tuberculosis (TB) burden area in China, Dazu District of Chongqing Municipality contains a large rural population and exhibits typical features of TB endemicity.ObjectiveThis study aimed to analyze the epidemiological characteristics and treatment outcomes of pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) in Dazu District from 2005 to 2024, with the aim of supporting the optimization of regional TB control strategies.

pmc-13047536.title: Maternal Choline Supplementation in a Mouse Model of Down Syndrome and Alzheimer’s Disease Generates Unique Expression Profile Mosaics Within Three Hippocampal Excitatory Neuronal Populations
pmc-13047536.creator: Melissa J Alldred, Kyrillos W Ibrahim, Harshitha Pidikiti, Sang Han Lee, Adriana Heguy, Gabriela Chiosis, Elliott J Mufson, Grace E Stutzmann, Stephen D Ginsberg
pmc-13047536.description: Individuals with Down syndrome (DS) are at risk for early‐onset Alzheimer's disease (AD), marked by neurodegeneration in hippocampal and basal forebrain circuits. Early‐life interventions offer therapeutic potential, including maternal choline supplementation (MCS). MCS improves cognitive outcomes and neuroplasticity in rodent models of neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders, yet cell‐type specific molecular effects remain unknown.

pmc-13338575.title: Single‐Cell and Multiomics Characterization of p21 in Cancer Progression and Therapeutic Sensitivity
pmc-13338575.creator: Wenyang Zhang, Qinglong Ma, Honghui Zhao, Wenrun Li, Zidong Feng, Linghui Zhong, Yaru Ren, Lin Chang, Yonghong Li, Lei Shi, Hao Chi
pmc-13338575.description: Introduction CDKN1A (encoding p21) is a canonical regulator of cell cycle arrest and genomic stability. However, its functional spectrum within the tumor microenvironment (TME), especially at single‐cell resolution, remains insufficiently defined.MethodsWe performed an integrative multiomics analysis combining bulk transcriptomics, single‐cell RNA sequencing (scRNA‐seq), and functional assays across multiple cancer types.

pmc-13371507.title: FOXR2-Mediated CNS Neuroblastoma in a Pediatric Patient Treated With Multimodal Therapy Including Proton Craniospinal Irradiation: A Case Report
pmc-13371507.creator: Waseem Syed, Chetan Shah, Leticia Schaefer

pmc-13384161.title: Implementation and economic analysis of a perioperative brain healthcare bundle: a mixed-methods study
pmc-13384161.creator: Sita Saunders, Kim Seemann, Tobias Muench, Rhodri Saunders, Nady Sfeir, Finn M Radtke, Basak C Meco, Joana Berger-Estilita
pmc-13384161.description: Study typeMixed-methods observational implementation and economic evaluation study.BackgroundPerioperative care bundles have the potential to improve patient outcomes but their successful implementation depends on staff engagement and the resources required. Data on implementation costs and staff perceptions are limited for perioperative brain health initiatives.

pmc-13599657.title: Spinel ferrites and their composites photocatalysts for CO2 conversion to solar fuels: A review
pmc-13599657.creator: Ruoqiao Zhou, Haoyu Wang, Yuefa Jia
pmc-13599657.description: SummarySpinel ferrite (MFe2O4, M= Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Sn, Mn, Ca, and Mg) nanomaterials have attracted enormous attention for CO2 photoreduction due to their superparamagnetic properties, narrow band gap, and suitable band position. However, a review about MFe2O4 and its composites for CO2 photoconversion is still absent.

pmc-13621655.title: Wound infections due to factory gunpowder and pyrotechnic explosions in patients with burn injury: risk factors and antimicrobial resistance
pmc-13621655.creator: Jinfu Li, Yueying Fan, Xiangong Jiao, Ming Zou, Zhangjia Jiang, Cheng Li, Shiqiang Jiang, Chiyu Jia
pmc-13621655.description: BackgroundA substantial obstacle in the treatment of burn patients is the management of burn wound infection (BWI). The objective of this investigation was to assess the antimicrobial susceptibility test results and distribution characteristics of microorganisms isolated from the burn wounds of patients affected by the factory gunpowder and pyrotechnic explosions.
